notes: Django 4.1.2 + DRF + allauth + rest-auth + channels on Python 3.9, fresh SQLite (the repo's db.sqlite3 and media/ uploads were not used). The only custom web page in this repo is the public landing page (templates/home/home_page.html, served at /); everything else is REST API (customers post cargo services, drivers send offers, orders) plus an unstyled channels chat test page. The landing page is static, so no sample records were needed - text and images are the project's own. Doubts: (1) this repo is the early TruckGo backend (page title and branding 'TruckGo', cargo transport in Sudan), so 'Services Platform' and 'TruckGo Web' are two generations of the same product and their landing pages look alike; for truckgo-web a different page (admin dashboard) was shot to keep them distinct. (2) Viewport: at exactly 1120 CSS px the template's header wraps and the menu icon overlaps the logo (the template only settles at >=1200px), so this shot was laid out at 1280x800 CSS px and captured at 1.75x - the PNG is still 2240x1400. The strict 1120px version is kept at web/services-platform-1120-alt.png. (3) The header shows the project's own placeholder phone 000-000-0000 and the project's contact e-mail as written in the template.
